sentences.text: This is an application filed under Section 438 of the Code of the Criminal Procedure seeking anticipatory bail.
2. The petitioner is the accused in Crime No. 362/2023 of Ramapuram Police Station.
The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 420, 406 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The prosecution case is that, on 04.10.2022, the petitioner, with the dishonest intention to cheat the defacto complainant, offered a Visa for securing a job in UK and collected an amount of Rs.2,80,000/- from him.

Thereafter a further amount of Rs.1,30.000/- was collected, offering the Alex Philip Mattom vs The State Of Kerala on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46694320/
1 defacto complainant a partnership in the new recruiting agency for the husband of the defacto complainant.

entities.text: Alex Philip Mattom vs The State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: None of the said promises were fulfilled, and the amounts were also not repaid.
The complaint was submitted in such circumstances, and the crime was registered accordingly.
Now, as the petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with the investigation of the said case, this application for anticipatory bail is submitted.

3. Heard, Sri. M Anuroop, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt. Seetha S, the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the State.
4.

Today, when the matter came up for consideration, the learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the investigation in this case is already over, and the final report has been submitted.
In such circumstances, the question of the custodial interrogation of the petitioner does not arise.

Hence this application is disposed of, clarifying that the petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional Court as and when required.
Sd/-
